summary: Completed comprehensive testing of video posts feature including chunked upload, transcoding, feed filtering, and UI integration. All backend APIs and frontend flows working correctly.
passed_tests: Backend: Login with arin.landing@voiladi.com
Backend: Video post flow (init -> chunk -> complete -> ready) with ffmpeg transcoding
Backend: Init rejects videos > 60s duration (400 error)
Backend: Init rejects non-video content types (400 error)
Backend: GET /api/posts/feed excludes processing/failed posts
Backend: GET /api/posts/mine includes video posts with kind/status fields
Backend: DELETE /api/posts/{id} removes video and media files (404 after deletion)
Backend: Image posts still work (multipart upload)
Backend: Video file accessible via GET /api/media/{id}.mp4 with Range support (206)
Backend: Poster accessible via GET /api/media/{id}_poster.jpg
Frontend: /profile shows Posts|Saved segmented control (profile-tab-track, profile-tab-posts, profile-tab-saved)
Frontend: /profile correctly hides profile-completion-card, profile-features, profile-menu
Frontend: Clicking Saved tab shows profile-saved-grid
Frontend: /settings shows Account row in Profile group (settings-account-row)
Frontend: /settings shows Saved row in Profile group (settings-saved-row)
Frontend: Clicking Saved in settings navigates to /saved
Frontend: /posts/new accepts video files via file input
Frontend: /posts/new shows new-post-video-preview for video
Frontend: /posts/new shows new-post-mute-toggle for video
Frontend: Share button enabled after video selection
Frontend: After posting, navigates to /p/{id}
Frontend: Post view shows feed-post-video element when ready
Frontend: Video element has data-ready=true when loaded
Frontend: /discover loads and displays feed posts
Frontend: No console errors during video upload/playback
